stretch_verdicts.daiso: Most of the layout in this stretch is wrong. (1) The model's Daiso/annex B1 is mirrored end for end. The photos and the route-map signs (#155, #163) put GATE1 at the WEST end after the jewelry row. GATE2 opens off the south side of the aisle, GATE3 is at the EAST end, and GATE4 sits at the end of a branch running north. The official B1 sub-map agrees. The model has 'GATE 4' + Disney + the G11 link at the west end and '1번 출입구' + 한가람 + the 단차 dip at the east end. (2) The photographed main aisle runs along the model's north 'public corridor' line (gb v≈5–8). The model walls this line off from the store with a solid wall at v=8 and lines it with other tenants' shopfronts. The store's own aisle (v 13–16) runs into the GATE2 stair enclosure. (3) The whole north wing is missing: Disney aisle, GATE4 checkouts, the GATE4 hall with its street stair and the G11 down-stair. So #165–#181 render from under the ground. (4) In Goto Mall, G11 and the '중앙광장 GOTO ZONE' plaza are modelled ~100 m west. The model's G13 gate + street stair stand on the real G11 mouth (#182–184 render inside it), so the real G13 hall, the G13 stair and its street canopy at GS칼텍스 don't exist. The ~2 m level step between Daiso and the mall is also missing. The east-zone corridor between the plaza and G13 (#185–#199) is close: same shop rhythm, oval coves and tactile line. It mainly needs finishes (glossy speckled granite, sky-print oval coves, cream-marble columns) and named tenants. Outside, GS칼텍스 is only the generic beige 3-storey OSM octagon. The real station has a 2-storey teal office, a canopy, pumps and a pole sign, and the sidewalk outside it carries the G13 canopy, a lift box, a bus-stop curb and a paved footway; none of these are built.
stretch_verdicts.gb1f: The 1F stretch has a usable skeleton, but three structural problems change what the walk sees. Several smaller relocations come on top of them. Coordinates below are world x,z, with gyeongbu local (u,v) in brackets. The frame is x=2.3+0.9348u+0.3552v and z=-59.24-0.3552u+0.9348v. +u runs ENE along the north wing and v=0 is the north facade. (1) North-wing bays are numbered the wrong way round. The real bays run 17→39 from west to east: 20/21 at u≈125, 22–24 at u≈150, 34/35 at u≈220, 38/39 at u≈250. Bay 40 is the arrival bay (도착 대합실) at the east end. The model puts 8 '하차장' at the west end and 17 at u≈307. (2) The north-wing section is wrong. The model has a full 2F slab and a 3.3 m ceiling everywhere. In reality the window-side nave is a 7 m double-height void from the bamboo screen (u≈258) to the HOLLYS/FOOD STATION mezzanine (u≈168), plus a steel-truss void at u≈118–140 with a 1F→2F escalator. HOLLYS/FOOD STATION and the truss hall have been built in the main building instead. (3) The main hall's ticket office (TICKETS 매표소) and its B1 escalators sit at the wrong ends. The model has the ticket office at v≈137–156 and the B1 escalator at u20.5/v131 running north–south. Really, the ticket office is on the walkway's west side at v≈33–42, just south of the atrium. Two escalator banks with oak bleachers between them descend west from u≈47 to u≈32 at v≈68–83. The model also fills the real walkway (u≈54–62) with food stalls, and puts its corridor directly against the bay wall, where the real building has an oak-arch screen and a waiting room. The NE atrium, the arrival hall, the B&C vestibule with its Daiso GATE 3 stair, and the street-facing north facade without a deep arcade are missing or simplified. Tenants east of 압구정칼국수김밥 sit 35–45 m too far west. The 1F→B1 escalator move, removing the Daiso well in the arrival hall, and the new GATE 3 stair all move B1 landings, so they need coordinating with B1. Already close to the photos: the grey-green marble strip floor of the north wing, the orange-fascia food pavilions, the tactile spine, the bronze 승차홈 sign style, cream wall tones, window-wall rhythm, and the general tenant order from 이디야 to 북촌손만두.
stretch_verdicts.gbb1: The stretch is far from the photos. Below street level the model has the right ingredients (food units, 노브랜드, the factory store, 한가람, the 단차 stairs, a Daiso double door) but most of them are in the wrong place. The official B1 schematic (n_floorb01/_sub) and the walk agree on the real layout, and the model does not match it. (1) Nothing is built beyond the B1 west door. The user walked into the 3호선 대합실/ENTER6 hall and back within 24 s, but the model has a closed wall there and an open-sky void (renders #74-77 show street level from below). The station module's ENTER6 hall is about 140 m away at (-92,-63). (2) The main-building 식당가 is about 35 m too far south and arranged wrongly. The real B1 has an E-W escalator pair landing at u≈31,v≈71 in front of an LED wall, two N-S corridors either side of a double-fronted island (5-9 | corridor | 10-14 | east concourse), an E-W corridor to the west door, units 1-4 facing north at v≈95, a T-junction at KB/노브랜드 (v≈42), and an E-W corridor (놀부주방·전주콩나물·밥장인) leading to the factory store entrance at u≈51. The model has a single corridor at v 70-120, 1-4 at v 126-154, a N-S escalator at v 131 and no escalator at the real spot. (3) The factory store sits about 30 m too far south, and the diagonal corridor is filled with west-facing units. (4) The north strip is mirrored along u. In reality 한가람 lines both sides of u 70-122, the 단차 is at u 137-152, the jewelry corridor and a white hall are at u 152-170, and Daiso GATE1 faces west at u≈170. The model puts 한가람, the 단차 and GATE1 at the far east end (u 244-282) and starts the Daiso room at u 142. The model's 37·38 box and escalator/stair well also block the 부속 corridor at u 100-111. Colours and materials are roughly right in spirit (light tiles, acoustic ceiling, brown signs), but these are missing: the LED wall and LED columns, the marble/stainless 3호선 look, 한가람 maroon, the 단차 granite with red rings, the glossy jewelry corridor with mirror piers, and the factory store's mesh fascia with red neon.
